text:
Type: melange woven throw
Use: warmth on a sofa, armchair or bed, layering; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: soft woven yarn with a slightly fuzzy brushed texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, white flecks
Shape: folded rectangle, heathered melange surface, plain hemmed edges, soft and drapey, light visual weight
Feel: cozy, calm, warm, understated
Goes with: light grey or white sofas, light wood, black accents, wool; Scandinavian, minimalist or industrial rooms
